## SC-001  REQ-1  P0 happy  — valid SAVE20 reduces total
data:   consumer segment "first_time_gofood" payment "gopay"        # TestBuddy: CustomerAgent
        gopay balance ">= cart_total"                               # TestBuddy: recharge_customer_gopay
        promo "SAVE20" valid                                        # TestBuddy: VoucherAgent
open deeplink "gojek://food/cart/review"                            # navigation via PLAN hook HOOK-DL-CART
enter "SAVE20" into "GOFOOD_CART_REVIEW.promo_input"
